title: Pagination with honest metadata
prompt:
Implement `paginate(items, page=1, per_page=20)` returning a dict with `items` (the window), `page`, `per_page`, `total`, `total_pages` (minimum 1), `has_next` (there are items after this window), `has_prev` (page > 1).

- raise `ValueError` when `page < 1` or `per_page` outside 1..100 (ints only)
- an empty list is 1 page with `has_next=False`

tests.name: windows and metadata agree
tests.code:
items = list(range(25))
p1 = paginate(items, 1, 10)
assert p1['items'] == list(range(10)) and p1['total'] == 25 and p1['total_pages'] == 3
assert p1['has_next'] is True and p1['has_prev'] is False
p3 = paginate(items, 3, 10)
assert p3['items'] == [20, 21, 22, 23, 24] and p3['has_next'] is False and p3['has_prev'] is True
print('ok')
tests.hint: ceil(total/per_page) pages; the last window may be short.

tests.name: empty lists and rejected params
tests.hint: Reject the contract violations; empty input is valid, not an error.
